cases.title: Verify April does not have 31 days

source.procedure:
1. Launch the application.
2. Enter 31 in Day.
3. Enter 4 in Month.
4. Enter 2026 in Year.
5. Click Check.
source.expected: A message box is displayed with: “31/4/2026 is NOT correct date time!”

notes: Lab dùng ngày không đệm số 0; bản thực hành dùng dd/mm/yyyy. Chế độ strict-source giữ nguyên message của Lab và có thể FAIL vì khác định dạng.

source.procedure:
1. Launch the Date Time Checker application.
2. Observe the main application window.
source.expected:
The main form is displayed correctly with the following UI elements:
• FU Logo is displayed in a picture box at the top-left corner.
• The text “Date Time Checker” is displayed in Blue, using Arial font, size 26.
• The labels “Day”, “Month”, and “Year” are displayed and left-aligned.
• Three textboxes are displayed for entering Day, Month, and Year.
• Two buttons, “Clear” and “Check”, are displayed.
• The form does not contain Maximize and Minimize buttons.

source.procedure:
1. Launch the application.
2. Click the X button at the top-right corner.
3. Observe the confirmation dialog.
source.expected:
A confirmation dialog is displayed correctly with:
• Dialog title displayed at the top.
• Information icon displayed.
• Message area displayed.
• Two action buttons displayed.
• Close X button displayed at the top-right corner of the dialog.

source.procedure:
1. Launch the application.
2. Observe the Clear button on the main screen.
source.expected:
The Clear button is displayed correctly on the main form.
• Button text is “Clear”.
• The button is visible and positioned beside the Check button as shown in the required layout.
